purpose: `DeathReport` is a comprehensive, production-ready death and kill tracking package for Nevermore. It provides centralized event orchestration, reactive stream observers (`Observable`), automatic stats tracking, and ultra-compact network replication via **ByteNet** and **PlayerIdService**.
description: `DeathReport` is a comprehensive, production-ready death and kill tracking package for Nevermore. It provides centralized event orchestration, reactive stream observers (`Observable`), automatic stats tracking, and ultra-compact network replication via **ByteNet** and **PlayerIdService**.

Client/DeathReportBindersClient.luau.description: Registers client-side death report binders with BinderProvider.

Client/Stats/PlayerDeathTrackerClient.lu.description: Client-side tracker for player deaths. Public entry points include `PlayerDeathTrackerClient.new`, `PlayerDeathTrackerClient.GetDeathValue`, `PlayerDeathTrackerClient.GetPlayer`, `PlayerDeathTrackerClient.GetKills`, `PlayerDeathTrackerClient.Destroy`.

Client/Stats/PlayerKillTrackerClient.lua.description: Client-side tracker for player kills. Public entry points include `PlayerKillTrackerClient.new`, `PlayerKillTrackerClient.GetKillValue`, `PlayerKillTrackerClient.GetPlayer`, `PlayerKillTrackerClient.GetKills`, `PlayerKillTrackerClient.Destroy`.

Client/Stats/TeamKillTrackerClient.luau.description: Client-side tracker for team kills. Public entry points include `TeamKillTrackerClient.new`, `TeamKillTrackerClient.GetKillValue`, `TeamKillTrackerClient.GetTeam`, `TeamKillTrackerClient.GetKills`, `TeamKillTrackerClient.Destroy`.

DeathReportServiceClient.luau.description: Centralized death reporting service which can be used to track deaths on the client. Public entry points include `DeathReportServiceClient.Init`, `DeathReportServiceClient.Start`, `DeathReportServiceClient.ObservePlayerKillerReports`, `DeathReportServiceClient.ObservePlayerDeathReports`, `DeathReportServiceClient.ObserveHumanoidKillerReports`, `DeathReportServiceClient.ObserveHumanoidDeathReports`,…

Shared/DeathReportNetwork.luau.description: ByteNet protocol schema for DeathReport with compact uint8 Player IDs.

Shared/DeathReportProcessor.luau.description: Handles shared observable subscription tables for the client and server. Public entry points include `DeathReportProcessor.new`, `DeathReportProcessor.ObservePlayerKillerReports`, `DeathReportProcessor.ObservePlayerDeathReports`, `DeathReportProcessor.ObserveHumanoidDeathReports`, `DeathReportProcessor.ObserveHumanoidKillerReports`, `DeathReportProcessor.ObserveCharacterKillerReports`,…

Shared/DeathReportServiceConstants.luau.description: Read-only package configuration constants for DeathReport.

Shared/DeathReportUtils.luau.description: Stateless utility functions for death report construction and inspection. Public entry points include `DeathReportUtils.fromDeceasedHumanoid`, `DeathReportUtils.create`, `DeathReportUtils.isDeathReport`, `DeathReportUtils.isWeaponData`, `DeathReportUtils.createWeaponData`, `DeathReportUtils.getDeadDisplayName`, `DeathReportUtils.involvesPlayer`, `DeathReportUtils.getKillerDisplayName`.

Shared/Stats/PlayerKillTrackerUtils.luau.description: Stateless utility functions for player kill trackers. Public entry points include `PlayerKillTrackerUtils.create`, `PlayerKillTrackerUtils.observeBrio`, `PlayerKillTrackerUtils.getPlayerKillTracker`.

Shared/Stats/TeamKillTrackerUtils.luau.description: Stateless utility functions for team kill trackers. Public entry points include `TeamKillTrackerUtils.create`, `TeamKillTrackerUtils.observeBrio`, `TeamKillTrackerUtils.getTeamKillTracker`.
